title: Ink Bomb
tagline: One drop per round. Everything it touches goes off too.
controls: Tap where you want the drop to land. That is the whole game.
On a keyboard: arrow keys move the crosshair, `Space` drops it.
Each round names a number you have to catch. Miss it and it costs a life.
about:
Ink dots drift across the page. You get exactly one detonation, and whatever it swallows detonates in turn.

So the round is decided before you commit: not where the dots are, but where they are going to be four seconds from now, and which of them will take the others with it. A drop into the thickest crowd is usually the wrong drop.

Each round adds dots and raises the quota. Nothing here is quick reflexes — it is one patient decision, over and over, with the price going up.
